code_snippet: .decisions[] | walk(if type == "string" then rw else . end)
reasoning_trace: op_import validates the pending file without a base (:627), rewrites only PEND ids (:642-644) and appends rows verbatim (:646); verify_and_swap checks ids/counts/untouched rows only; validate-artifact.sh:686 constrains new rows only under a live unattended signal. Reproduced: a pending row with status decided, decided_by operator and a forged operator transition imported with exit 0 and passed the validator.
finding: import lets an agent-authored pending file mint operator-decided rows, bypassing /decisions confirm.
critique: The one invariant the feature exists to enforce is bypassable through the lead's routine import step.
remediation: Fail import on any row not open|proposed with decided_by null and creation-only transitions; mirror the rule in the validator for rows absent from --base-file regardless of the unattended flag; add a negative test beside tests/unit/dec-write-lib.bats:391.

code_snippet: if is_unattended; then [[ -z "$ref" ]] || warn "unattended context: --answer-ref ignored ..."; return 0; fi
reasoning_trace: ctx_signals emits a prd signal for a PRD **Status:** line naming autonomous/unattended (:177-180); is_unattended covers it (:183) while op_confirm refuses only on live_run_signal (:509). Reproduced: operator confirm with cli ref recorded decided_by agent; operator reject of a decided row refused; operator supersede took the agent branch leaving the old row decided.
finding: The PRD Status signal downgrades and misattributes the operator's own confirm/reject/supersede.
critique: A planning-time artifact that outlives the run controls the attribution of interactive operator actions.
remediation: Gate confirm, reject, supersede, context --clear and their derive_attribution on live_run_signal alone; keep the PRD signal for new/decide only; add attribution tests.

reasoning_trace: Suites seed fixtures from the live ledger (dec-write-lib.bats:28,121; grimoire-index.bats:80; validate-artifact.bats:630,644); head.diff adds no such file; base .gitignore:149 lists it under template exclusions and the change only adds a negation at :150; the writer dies at :271 with no init subcommand. Reproduced: without a ledger 44/44, 48/51 and 7/12 tests fail; with a seeded ledger 144/145 pass.
finding: The change depends on a tracked grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml it does not ship, and the writer cannot create it.
critique: A red suite on merge blocks later sprints; downstream projects cannot bootstrap the ledger.
remediation: Ship the seeded ledger or add an init subcommand; write the header in the tests instead of reading the live file; remove the ignore line rather than negating it; state the seeding in the PR.

reasoning_trace: The flag is the whole check behind confirm (:508), reject of a decided row (:574), the immediate superseded branch (:600,:606) and context --clear (:716). disable-model-invocation hides /decisions from the Skill tool only; lint tests grep checked-in text. Reproduction scenario D ran confirm --recorded-by decisions-command from a shell script and got decided_by operator. Both dissent voices raised it (DISS-001, DISS-C-001).
finding: The operator-only boundary is a self-asserted CLI flag; any Bash-capable session confirms its own proposals as the operator.
critique: decisions.md:3 claims the model cannot invoke it; the stated threat (an agent confirming its own decisions) is exactly what one Bash call achieves.
remediation: Add a PreToolUse Bash fence for dec-write-lib.sh confirm|reject|supersede|context --clear and --recorded-by decisions-command outside a fresh /decisions marker; log operator-op invocations; rewrite decisions.md and the writer header to describe the actual enforcement.

code_snippet: if has file; then TARGET="$(o file)"; TARGET_KIND="fixture"; ...; return 0; fi
reasoning_trace: resolve_target returns fixture for any --file before the ci_blocked check (:261) and the worktree redirect; op_import skips its checks under --file (:622). Reproduced: CI=1 new --file grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml exit 0, row landed.
finding: --file <live path> writes the live ledger from CI, GitHub Actions or a hook.
remediation: Canonicalise --file, classify live|pending|fixture by path, apply the guards to live and pending.

reasoning_trace: op_reject never touches the superseded target's supersede_proposed_by; :601 then refuses every later agent supersede. Reproduced. validate-artifact.sh:681 permits only setting the field.
finding: A rejected replacement permanently blocks agent supersede of the original decision.
remediation: Clear the target's supersede_proposed_by in the same reject write and allow that change in the validator for a -> rejected transition.

reasoning_trace: Operator supersede moves the old row to superseded while the replacement is proposed; rejecting the replacement leaves no decided successor; validator exit 0. Reproduced.
finding: Operator supersede can silently leave the ledger with no live decision.
remediation: Keep the operator path symmetric with the agent path, or write the replacement decided in the same write when an operator-kind --answer-ref is present.

reasoning_trace: verify_and_swap commits (:647) before the --rewrite loop (:649-654) and rm -f (:655); under set -e a failing mktemp exits with the pending file kept. Reproduced: import #1 exit 1, import #2 exit 0, DEC-0001 and DEC-0002 identical.
finding: import is not retry-safe; a failed --rewrite duplicates rows on re-run.
remediation: Stage rewrites before the swap, or record the PEND->DEC map so a re-run is idempotent.

reasoning_trace: Three texts require dec-write-lib.sh new in unattended runs; the writer refuses live writes under CI/GITHUB_ACTIONS/LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT (:261); the NOTES.md fallback was removed.
finding: CI-hosted unattended runs are told to write the ledger where the writer refuses, with no fallback.
remediation: Document --pending --sprint N plus import, or restore the NOTES.md Decision Log pointer as the fallback.

reasoning_trace: list --format md strips controls and escapes pipes only; its output is shown in the privileged /decisions session before the operator's yes (decisions.md:50-52), copied into PRD/SDD appendices and into PR bodies (render-templates.md:106-116); the hook, by contrast, refuses to print without the L6 fence. Raised by dissent DISS-C-005.
finding: Agent-authored rows reach the privileged /decisions session and outward surfaces without the L6 fence or a cap.
remediation: Add a fenced mode to list --format md or pipe through the L6 sanitizer at those surfaces; cap free-text cells.

reasoning_trace: validate_decisions spans :527-728, one 120-line jq program with the base comparison inline; op_confirm (dec-write-lib.sh:506-558) is 53 lines.
finding: Two functions exceed the 50-line ceiling without justification.
remediation: Move the jq rules to a .jq file loaded with jq -f; split the base comparison; extract op_confirm's supersede follow-through.

reasoning_trace: The implementation report is the PR title plus a file count; no AC Verification, no bats/shellcheck output, no statement of how the ledger is seeded; no documentation-coherence report exists for the task.
finding: The implementation report carries no acceptance-criteria verification or test evidence.
remediation: Add the AC walkthrough with file:line evidence and paste the lint/test output.

reasoning_trace: Every md cell passes through mc except (\(.id)); :535 echoes the raw summary to stderr. Reproduced with a hand-edited id adding table cells.
finding: The md renderer interpolates .id raw and prints the raw summary to stderr.
remediation: Route .id through mc or the id grammar; clean the stderr echo.

reasoning_trace: confirm without --answer-ref sets decided_by to proposed_by (agent) while the transition says by operator:decisions-command; pinned by tests/unit/dec-write-lib.bats:186-188. Reproduced.
finding: A confirmed row can say the operator moved it and the agent decided it.
remediation: Require an operator-kind --answer-ref for confirm.

reasoning_trace: The flag loop rejects --help as unknown (exit 2) and tells the user to see --help; only a bare --help reaches :739. Reproduced.
finding: <subcommand> --help is a usage error.
remediation: Handle -h|--help inside the flag loop.

reasoning_trace: The md branch always appends 'Confirm with /decisions confirm.'; reproduced with --status decided.
finding: The confirm prompt is rendered when no listed row is proposed.
remediation: Emit the line only when a rendered row is proposed.

reasoning_trace: Banner lists observation (removed cycle-121) and omits decisions; :204 adds voice to every family's JSON record without a note.
finding: Stale INDEX.md banner and an undocumented JSON schema field.
remediation: Update the banner; document voice in the header.

reasoning_trace: BLOCK_RE uses greedy \[.*\]; two blocks on one physical line merge into one malformed match; one per line is documented.
finding: Greedy regex merges adjacent round blocks on one line.
remediation: Match <!--[^>]*--> then filter, or split on --> first.

reasoning_trace: artifact_path canonicalises the directory only; -f follows a symlink; an in-project symlink to an outside file passes the prefix check and regex and is hashed. Raised by dissent DISS-C-006.
finding: A symlinked evidence artifact can point outside the project.
remediation: Reject symlinks or resolve the file itself before the prefix check.

reasoning_trace: emit_decisions strips controls, caps at 160 and escapes pipes but does not constrain id/status to their grammars as the hook does (loa-decisions-surface.sh:75). Raised by dissent DISS-C-007.
finding: A crafted id carries markdown or whitespace into the generated INDEX.md and JSON index.
remediation: Reduce id to [A-Za-z0-9-]{1,16} and status to the known values.
